svg.metadata: {"story":"Abraham","act":4,"chapter":"Rescue of Lot","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Four eastern kings overrun Sodom and take Lot captive; Abram arms his trained servants and pursues by night, routing the invaders and refusing any spoil. Stage: torchlit desert march, dust and silhouettes, a swift dawn battle north of Damascus; Abram refusing the king of Sodom's offer on a moonlit plain.","materials":["assets/materials/desert_sand-dunes.svg","assets/materials/water_still-eddies.svg"],"seed":1}
